about: Broken copies of the goal rounds (examples/goal-reached for 01 to 03, examples/goal-missed for 04). Each copy is a different cheat and fails on the checks listed.

copies.name: 01-refund-to-a-contributor
copies.story: The goal was reached, so every payment is kept. The seller still lists a 500,000 refund for Alice that never happened.

copies.name: 02-says-goal-missed-when-reached
copies.story: The 6,500,000 collected beats the 6,000,000 goal. The seller says the goal was missed and lists everyone as refunded.

copies.name: 03-goal-raised-after-the-fact
copies.story: The disclosure now shows a goal of 7,000,000, higher than the 6,000,000 the result was built on, so the goal looks missed while the seller keeps the money.

copies.name: 04-says-goal-reached-when-missed
copies.story: Only 1,500,000 came in against a goal of 2,000,000. The seller says the goal was reached and keeps Carol's money, though her refund went out on the chain.
